content.title: 2026 Building Permit Fee Schedule — City of Arvada, CO
content.summary: Administrative fee schedule effective January 1, 2026 for all Building Services permits. Most permit fees are based on project valuation (Table 18-1). Flat-rate fees apply to common residential work (Table 18-5). Contractor license fees are in Table 18-8.
content.eligibility: Anyone applying for a building, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or specialty permit in Arvada. Tax-exempt organizations (religious, charitable, governmental) may obtain a Colorado '89' exemption certificate to waive use tax.

steps.title: Determine valuation
steps.text: Use the higher of: (a) actual contract value, or (b) the Building Valuation Table 18-2 (91.1% of August 2025 ICC / RS Means 83rd edition 2025). Valuation must include all construction work and permanent equipment — finish work, fixtures, HVAC, elevators, fire systems.

steps.title: Look up permit fee in Table 18-1
steps.text: Apply the tiered fee formula from Table 18-1 to your project valuation. Flat-rate permits (Table 18-5) use a fixed fee instead.

steps.title: Add plan review fee (if required)
steps.text: Residential plan review = 65% of permit fee. Single-family modification = $40 flat. Electrical/plumbing/mechanical not on combination permit = 50% of total permit fee. Commercial = 65% of permit fee.

steps.title: Apply for permit and pay
steps.text: Submit online at arvadapermits.org (SMART License & Permits), by email to Building Permits Division, or in person at City Hall. Pay online, in-person, or by phone. Accepted: cash, check, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express.

form_fields.description: Total value of construction including all work and permanent equipment. Must be the higher of actual contract value or Table 18-2 valuation.
form_fields.why_needed: Used to calculate permit fee from Table 18-1.

form_fields.label: Arvada Business License Number
form_fields.description: If you are an Arvada Business license holder who pays taxes quarterly, provide this to apply appropriate tax treatment.

timelines.review: Simple permits (roofing, residential plumbing, electrical, mechanical): issued within 1 business day of complete application. Major projects (new single-family, commercial): 4 to 6 weeks for first plan review.
timelines.inspection: Schedule by 6 am of desired inspection date. Inspections Mon–Fri 8am–4pm. Schedule at arvadapermits.org or call 720-898-7630 (automated line). Someone 18+ must be present.

faqs.q: How is the permit fee calculated for a $25,000 renovation?
How much does a solar permit cost?
How much does an EV charger permit cost?
How much does a heat pump permit cost?
What is use tax and how is it calculated?
faqs.a: Use tax is 3.46% of the materials portion of the project valuation (58% of total). Collected per §98-84. Present your permit to vendors at purchase to avoid paying sales tax at the counter.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund if I cancel my permit?
faqs.a: Yes. If no plan review has started: 100% of plan review fees refunded. If permit issued but no work started: 80% of permit fee, 100% of use tax refunded. Requests must be submitted within 6 months of payment date.
